title: Chovah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: The wife of Rav Huna, as in Nazir 57b, where Rav Ada bar Ahavah asked Rav Huna, “Who cuts your sons’ hair?” He answered, “Chovah.” In Bava Kamma 80a they asked him, “Who guards your small livestock?” He answered, “Chovah.” He said to him, “May Chovah bury her sons.” So it was: all the years of Rav Ada bar Ahavah’s life, Rav Huna’s offspring from Chovah did not survive.

notes.text: The final sentence is compressed in the source; ר״א בר אהבה is rendered Rav Ada bar Ahavah after the preceding narrative.
